Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding payment of providers for medically needy consumers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to payment of providers for medically needyconsumers; and adding a new section to chapter 74.39A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For consumers who are medically needy, as defined in the socialsecurity Title XIX state plan, and are receiving services through anindividual provider or a home care agency provider, if the provider isnot paid by the consumer in a timely fashion, the department of socialand health services shall pay the provider and take such steps as maybe necessary to collect the debt from the consumer.
